findings.statement: Autar Krishen Rehbar has proved by detailed analysis and comparison that the basic lines are that of Arinimaal only.
Rehbar has clearly shown that these are two different poems, only its refrain, 'åríní rang gom shràvan híyè', is common in both.
Kamil says it is clear that the 'kävi víhínúm aríníní …' poem was not attached to Arinimaal as late as 1946.
